show.title: Don Dolly Aur Dulhaniya
show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/Rd5CQ4
show.description: The show follows Ishaan, a legendary "Underground Badshah" living in secrecy, who first abandons a toxic marriage with the ungrateful Gupta family after being humiliated. While evading secret agencies, he crosses paths with Vamika, a bold woman fleeing a forced marriage to the sleazy villain Gulshan Talwar. To protect her, Ishaan disguises himself as a lowly band player, eventually revealing his massive wealth and power to dismantle the corrupt Talwar and Kohli families.
